claims.core: AACAP tantrums: frustration/distress and physical needs; calm/nonviolent response. CDC two-year milestones supports predictable routines.
claims.ignoring: Current CDC redirecting-attention page confines ignoring to safe minor attention-seeking behavior, excludes needs/distress, and requires dangerous/destructive behavior to stop immediately.
claims.referral: AACAP tantrums: dangerous aggression/self-injury, inability to calm, frequency/severity or functional impairment warrant assessment; active serious safety concerns need immediate help.
claims.timing: External 15–20-minute rule not supported. AACAP gives different duration examples; none is made a prerequisite to safeguarding or referral.
